_note: ALL IMAGES ON THE SITE. Paste a link between the quotes of "url": a web address (https://...) or a file in the images folder (images/me.jpg). An empty url shows a gradient placeholder, so nothing breaks. "alt" is a short description for screen readers and search engines. _where tells you where the image appears and the best size. Images fill their frame and may be cropped at the edges; add "fit": "contain" to an image to show it whole instead (handy for screenshots).

portrait._where: About page — large photo on the left. Portrait 3:4, about 1200 × 1600 px.

logo._where: Round logo in the top-left corner. Square, about 200 × 200 px. Empty = your initials.

favicon._where: Small icon in the browser tab. Square PNG or SVG, 64 × 64 px.

_projectsNote: One block per project, with the SAME id as in projects.json. cover = the card in the Work slider/grid and the first image on the project page (landscape 16:10, about 1600 × 1000 px). gallery = extra images on the project page, in this order; add as many as you like.
